empty.title: Select an object
empty.description: Choose a layer, camera, or light to edit timing curves and keyframes.

fields.enabledDescription: Procedural value is added at render time

graph.addTwoKeyframes: Add two keyframes to see speed
graph.addKeyframes: Add keyframes to draw a curve
graph.flatSegment: Flat segment — handles have no effect

expression.empty: Add a safe expression preset to generate procedural motion for this property.

summary.loop: Loop repeats this property's keyframes after the last key.
summary.pingPong: Ping-pong repeats keyframes forward and backward.
summary.posterize: Posterize samples this property's value at a lower rate.
summary.expressionCode: Write a JavaScript expression: value, time, wiggle(), loopOut(), linear(), ease(), clamp(), random(), Math.

keyframes.emptyLayer: No keyframes on this property yet. Add one at the current playhead to start shaping motion.
keyframes.emptyCamera: No keyframes on this camera property yet. Add one at the current playhead to shape the scene move.
keyframes.emptyLight: No keyframes on this light property yet. Add one at the current playhead to animate the scene lighting.

keyframe.roveHint: Rove: derive this keyframe's time for constant speed between neighbors
keyframe.roveDisabled: The first and last keyframe of a property cannot rove

timing.duplicate: Duplicate keys forward by half a second
timing.reverseTitle: Reverse keys inside their current time span
timing.compress: Compress key timing to half speed span
timing.stretch: Stretch key timing to double speed span
